Question Choices: Seven cards are drawn without replacement from a pack of 20 cards, 6 of which are red. Counting red cards as successes, what are (N, m, n)? Choices: A) (20, 6, 7) | B) (20, 7, 6) | C) (6, 20, 7) | D) (7, 6, 20) Answer with the letter only.
Hints: N is the population size, m the number of successes in it, n the number of draws
Solution: $N=20$ cards, $m=6$ red cards, $n=7$ draws. The answer is A.
